company_name: ChangChun GuangHua Micro-Electronics Equipment Engineering Center Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in automation and intelligent manufacturing equipment for the microelectronics sector, including semiconductor production.
summary: ChangChun GuangHua Micro-Electronics Equipment Engineering Center Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced production equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on automation and precision machinery. Their offerings include laser trimming machines and dicing machines, which are essential for chip manufacturing and testing.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Changchun City, Jilin province, and its products are widely sold in China and abroad.
